framework.name: MITRE ATLAS (Adversarial Threat Landscape for Artificial-Intelligence Systems)
framework.description: Adversarial tactics, techniques, and case studies targeting machine learning and generative AI systems.

controls.title: LLM Prompt Injection
controls.description: Adversaries craft malicious prompts as inputs to an LLM that cause the LLM to act in unintended ways, bypassing safety instructions or hijacking application control flow.

controls.title: LLM Prompt Injection: Direct
controls.description: An adversary directly interacts with the LLM user input channel to override system instructions, escape prompt delimiters, or subvert model alignment constraints.

controls.title: LLM Prompt Injection: Indirect
controls.description: An adversary plants malicious instructions inside external data sources (documents, web pages, emails, RAG chunks) that the LLM ingests during a victim's session.

controls.title: LLM Jailbreak
controls.description: Adversaries use persona adoption, hypothetical framing, or encoding schemes to bypass safety guardrails and operational restrictions placed on an LLM.

controls.title: LLM Meta Prompt Extraction
controls.description: Adversaries elicit the confidential initial instructions (system prompt / meta prompt) given to an LLM to uncover proprietary logic, internal endpoints, or embedded secrets.

controls.title: False RAG Entry Injection / RAG Poisoning
controls.description: Adversaries inject crafted or poisoned passages into a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) knowledge base or retrieval context to manipulate generated outputs.

controls.title: Exfiltration via AI Agent or External Sink
controls.description: Adversaries exfiltrate sensitive context, credentials, or cross-tenant RAG documents by inducing the LLM to render external Markdown image beacons or invoke outbound agent tools.

controls.title: ML Model Inference API Access
controls.description: Adversaries abuse inference APIs via unbounded token generation requests, parameter manipulation, or metadata query probing to exhaust resources or extract sensitive data.

controls.title: Craft Adversarial Data
controls.description: Adversaries craft structured inputs, filter operator payloads, or tool parameter payloads designed to subvert downstream AI pipeline components.
